title.narrative: Innovación para la mejora de aprendizajes en CABA

description.narrative: The activity is implemented within an agreement with the Ministry of Education of the City of Buenos Aires, Argentina, to support innovation actions to improve learning. The project is framed in the collaboration between the agencies and the Ministry of Education of the City of Buenos Aires aimed at positioning this City as a hub of educational innovation. The objective is to strengthen the educational system through teacher training actions and middle bodies in the educational system that permeate the classroom and result in quality learning for students, both in fundamental literacies and in the new learning necessary to a full future. The specific objectives are: to implement a learning acceleration and improvement plan, as wel as strengthening and development of educational planning and management capabilities
